source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

midlane.quote: Poke with Particle Shredder, then lob Dread Nova to stun and follow with Ether Crystal so the storm stacks Disintegrate. After Spectral Schematics and Timewarp, start Synaptic Obliterator only from a safe spot once their divers have used their escapes.
midlane.issue: logic slip: divers spend their engage, not their escapes
midlane.rewrite: Poke with Particle Shredder, then lob Dread Nova to stun and follow with Ether Crystal so the storm stacks Disintegrate. After Spectral Schematics and Timewarp, start Synaptic Obliterator only from a safe spot once their divers have used their engage.

offlane.quote: Dash in with Forward Crunch, then weave a basic attack after each ability so Cross Crunch empowers it, using Right Crunch to slow them. Once Viper and Basilisk are done, use Re-Crunch to repeat your best hit as they try to escape.
offlane.issue: Re-Crunch repeats the LAST ability used, not your best hit
offlane.rewrite: Dash in with Forward Crunch, then weave a basic attack after each ability so Cross Crunch empowers it, using Right Crunch to slow them. Once Viper and Basilisk are done, cast Re-Crunch right after Right Crunch to repeat its slow as they try to escape.

midlane.quote: Black Hole roots you in place while it channels; if their team can still stun you, wait until they're spent.
midlane.issue: 'roots you' misuses a crowd-control term; Black Hole is a channel that holds you in place
midlane.rewrite: While you channel Black Hole you stay in place; if their team can still stun you, wait until they're spent.

midlane.quote: Lay H11 Cluster Grenades ahead of the wave, lob Land Mine behind your target to knock them into the grenades, then fire a charged R2000 Missile. Once Spirit Of Amir is done, keep casting so Armed Salvo refills your mana.
midlane.issue: misdescribes Armed Salvo: mana comes back from its empowered basic attack, casting only shortens its cooldown
midlane.rewrite: Lay H11 Cluster Grenades ahead of the wave, lob Land Mine behind your target to knock them into the grenades, then fire a charged R2000 Missile. Once Spirit Of Amir is done, weave a basic attack between casts so Armed Salvo refills your mana.

support.quote: Melee divers break turrets fast; against Dekker, which is theirs on our read, keep turrets behind you and save Inferno's knockback for her engage.
support.issue: pairs 'melee divers' with Dekker, implying she is a melee diver; misleading
support.rewrite: Against Dekker, which is theirs on our read, keep turrets behind you and save Inferno's knockback for her engage.

jungle.quote: Kwang wins this matchup on our read: do not fight him at his Blade, where he can teleport in; take camps on the other side.
jungle.issue: cites Kwang's Blade/teleport, which is not in the SOURCE and is jargon to a new player
jungle.rewrite: Kwang wins this matchup on our read: do not duel him early; take camps on the other side.

jungle.quote: This build's opener is a sim blind spot the field has lost with; if you fall behind early, follow the common build instead.
jungle.issue: jargon a new player won't get ('sim blind spot', 'the field', 'common build')
jungle.rewrite: Players who open with Orion have lost slightly more than they've won; if you fall behind early, switch to the build most players use.

carry.quote: This build's opener is a sim blind spot the field has lost with; if lane goes badly, copy the common carry build instead.
carry.issue: jargon: 'sim blind spot' means nothing to a new player
carry.rewrite: Players who open with Viper have lost more often, so if lane goes badly, switch to the build most carries use.

jungle.quote: Clear camps fast, then carry Boulder Throw into a lane and stun your target, follow with Pounce and Rumble to slow them. Once Spear Of Desolation is done around minute 15, use Behemoth to stay alive in fights.
jungle.rewrite: Clear camps fast, then carry Boulder Throw into a lane, stun your target, and follow with Pounce and Rumble to slow them. Once Spear Of Desolation is done around minute 15, use Behemoth to stay alive in fights.

support.quote: Stun a target with Boulder Throw, then Pounce in to knock them toward your carry and use Rumble to slow them. Once Inquisition and Stonewall are done, use Behemoth to stand in front of your team and soak hits.
support.issue: Pounce launches heroes backwards, away from Rampage, not toward your carry
support.rewrite: Stun a target with Boulder Throw, then Pounce in and use Rumble to slow them so your carry can follow up. Once Inquisition and Stonewall are done, use Behemoth to stand in front of your team and soak hits.
